Expensive but excellent experience.
Apr 2019 • Couples
Yen Sushi Premium is extremely atmospheric, complete with a kimono wearing attendant who will sit outside your private room.

Is it (relatively) expensive? Yes. It was not difficult to spend 3 million VND here between two people, but if that price does not scare you, you will have a very memorable meal with some unusual and delicious cuts of fish.

You could eat here more cheaply, ordering items from their barbeque menu and some of their cheaper sushi offerings.

Impressive Decor, Great Sashimi
Dec 2017 • Business
The top restaurants in Ho Chi Minh have incredible decors and this restaurant is up there with the best. Really authentic Japanese interior design with beautiful cutlery to match. Staff were not wearing usual uniforms but authentic kimonos. I was very impressed from the moment stepping in until leaving.
Sashimi was fresh and had some different fish I never had elsewhere. Food was delicious and plated nicely with dedication. The food quality matched the decor to perfection.
Look no further if you want to have authentic Japanese dining in Ho Chi Minh city.
